resources.string: Calendars on this phone in Mailr\'s calendar
The events of this phone\'s calendars are shown in Mailr\'s calendar, read-only. You allow calendar access when you turn this on.
Calendar access is not allowed. You can allow it in the app\'s system settings.
Calendar access was not allowed, so phone calendars stay off.
Titles and places are sent to your Mailr server; guests and descriptions are not.

Nothing is sent to the server for calendars set to Off or “Show on this phone”. For “Show and send busy times”, the start and end of each busy or tentative event are sent. For “Show and send details”, each event\'s title and place are sent as well. Guests, descriptions and notes are never sent.
This event cannot be opened: the phone has no calendar app.
This event is in a calendar on this phone. You can change it in the phone\'s calendar app.
